The '''Roundtree system''' was located in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Rekkon]] must have been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at some point before his appearance during the events of ''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rekkon]]<ref name="DB" /> was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in the Roundtree [[Star system/Legends|system]] as the only child in a middle class family.<ref name="HSCSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Roundtree system was first mentioned in the [[1993]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'', authored by [[Michael Allen Horne]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HSCSS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square M-14.<ref name="TEA" />
